sf_ip_blocklist_host.name: sf_ip_blocklist_host
sf_ip_blocklist_host.value: "sf_ip_blocklist"."ip_address" = host("sf_ip_blocklist"."ip_address"::inet) AND masklen("sf_ip_blocklist"."ip_address"::inet) = CASE family("sf_ip_blocklist"."ip_address"::inet) WHEN 4 THEN 32 ELSE 128 END

sf_countries_phone_digits_range_check.name: sf_countries_phone_digits_range_check
sf_countries_phone_digits_range_check.value: "sf_countries"."min_phone_digits" BETWEEN 4 AND 15 AND "sf_countries"."max_phone_digits" BETWEEN "sf_countries"."min_phone_digits" AND 15 AND "sf_countries"."max_phone_digits" + length("sf_countries"."phone_prefix") - 1 <= 15

sf_phone_otp_email_code_check.name: sf_phone_otp_email_code_check
sf_phone_otp_email_code_check.value: "sf_phone_otp_challenges"."delivery_channel" <> 'email' or "sf_phone_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('starting', 'pending') or "sf_phone_otp_challenges"."code_hash" is not null

sf_payment_attempt_reference_pair.name: sf_payment_attempt_reference_pair
sf_payment_attempt_reference_pair.value: ("sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference" is null and "sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference_hash" is null) or ("sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference" is not null and "sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference_hash" is not null and "sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference" ~ '^sfenc-v1\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' and octet_length("sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference")<=4096 and "sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

sf_payment_attempt_confirmable_reference.name: sf_payment_attempt_confirmable_reference
sf_payment_attempt_confirmable_reference.value: "sf_payment_attempts"."status" not in ('pending','succeeded') or "sf_payment_attempts"."provider_reference_hash" is not null

sf_customer_payment_links_amount_check.name: sf_customer_payment_links_amount_check
sf_customer_payment_links_amount_check.value:
("sf_customer_payment_links"."currency" = 'XOF' and "sf_customer_payment_links"."amount_minor" between 0 and 9007199254740991)
      or ("sf_customer_payment_links"."currency" = 'XAF' and "sf_customer_payment_links"."amount_minor" between 10 and 9007199254740991)
      or ("sf_customer_payment_links"."currency" in ('CHF','NGN','EUR','USD','CAD') and "sf_customer_payment_links"."amount_minor" between 1000 and 9007199254740991)

sf_customer_payment_links_usage_count_ch.name: sf_customer_payment_links_usage_count_check
sf_customer_payment_links_usage_count_ch.value: "sf_customer_payment_links"."usage_count" between 0 and 999999 and ("sf_customer_payment_links"."maximum_uses" is null or "sf_customer_payment_links"."usage_count" <= "sf_customer_payment_links"."maximum_uses")

sf_customer_payment_links_image_data_che.name: sf_customer_payment_links_image_data_check
sf_customer_payment_links_image_data_che.value:
("sf_customer_payment_links"."image_data" is null and "sf_customer_payment_links"."image_size_bytes" is null)
      or ("sf_customer_payment_links"."image_data" is not null and "sf_customer_payment_links"."image_size_bytes" between 1 and 5242880
        and octet_length("sf_customer_payment_links"."image_data") = "sf_customer_payment_links"."image_size_bytes")

sf_developer_api_keys_revoke_pair_check.name: sf_developer_api_keys_revoke_pair_check
sf_developer_api_keys_revoke_pair_check.value: ("sf_developer_api_keys"."status"='active' and "sf_developer_api_keys"."revoked_at" is null) or ("sf_developer_api_keys"."status"='revoked' and "sf_developer_api_keys"."revoked_at" is not null)

sf_developer_webhook_endpoints_revoke_pa.name: sf_developer_webhook_endpoints_revoke_pair_check
sf_developer_webhook_endpoints_revoke_pa.value: ("sf_developer_webhook_endpoints"."status"='active' and "sf_developer_webhook_endpoints"."revoked_at" is null) or ("sf_developer_webhook_endpoints"."status"='revoked' and "sf_developer_webhook_endpoints"."revoked_at" is not null)

sf_replit_payment_test_access_state_chec.name: sf_replit_payment_test_access_state_check
sf_replit_payment_test_access_state_chec.value:
("sf_replit_payment_test_access"."state"='active' AND "sf_replit_payment_test_access"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "sf_replit_payment_test_access"."revoked_by" IS NULL)
    OR ("sf_replit_payment_test_access"."state"='revoked' AND "sf_replit_payment_test_access"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sf_replit_payment_test_access"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL)
